verdict.rationale: Square documents API Explorer as an interactive web application for building, viewing, and sending HTTP requests to Square APIs against real Sandbox or production resources. It is complemented by API Logs for viewing requests and responses, and by a hosted GraphQL Explorer for running queries. Together these directly deliver an interactive, runnable API reference. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-endpoint runnable code samples within the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
